name: Paws and Recs
source:
The summer season is starting at Black Creek Beach. Liam is going to the annual orientation event for the 3rd year in a row for the Black Creek Beach Family! But this year is different, a new employee catches his eyes. Maybe this could be the start of great summer for his gay goat ass? We'll see!

[From [url=https://floofycotton.itch.io/paws-and-recs]Itch.io[/url]]
